name: value-complex
description: Avantis value-factor tracker — small-cap (AVUV) and large-cap (AVLV) value in one read, straight from TickerTrace's per-fund holdings. Groups by fund tier and by position lifecycle (new/exited, conviction tilt, up-streaks), ranked by weight, and surfaces the sector themes both funds agree on. Use when the user asks "what's the value factor doing", "what did AVUV/AVLV add", "new adds in value", "what are the value funds buying", "value complex", or wants the small-vs-large value read.
